SELECT t2.id, t2.process_instance_id, t2.task_id, t2.cur_approve_id, t2.start_time, t2.task_status, t2.timeout_handle_type, t2.approve_time, t2.remark, t2.cur_activity_id, t2.pre_activity_id, t2.execution_id, t2.approve_id, t2.cur_activity_name, t2.cur_approve_name, t2.approve_name, t2.timeout_status, t2.timeout_warn_time, t2.timeout_handle_time FROM "process_task_management" t1 left join "process_task_management" t2 on t1.process_instance_id = t2.process_instance_id where t1.is_deleted = false and t2.is_deleted = false and t1.process_instance_id = #{processInstanceId} and t1.id = #{taskManagementId} and t2.cur_activity_id = t1.pre_activity_id order by process_instance_id

SELECT pm.business_id businessId, ptm.ID taskId, ptm.approve_id approveUserId, ptm.approve_name approveUserName, ptm.approve_time approveTime, ptm.task_status approveStatus, ptm.cur_approve_id, ptm.cur_approve_name, ptm.remark FROM (select business_id,process_instance_id from process_management where is_deleted = FALSE and business_id = #{businessId} order by create_time desc limit 1 ) pm inner JOIN process_task_management ptm ON pm.process_instance_id = ptm.process_instance_id AND ptm.is_deleted = FALSE order by ptm.id
